'''Syreena''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who worked for [[Viidu]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Syreena worked as part of Viidu's crew at [[Fort Garnik]]. However, she secretly began to work for [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]], and had an affair with him. She was helped by the [[Voidhound|smuggler]] after being threatened by [[Bracco]]. After killing [[Viidu]], Syreena tried to hide this after Skavak's betrayal, but the smuggler had witnessed the entire exchange. She confessed to Ace that she briefly worked for Skavak, and apologized for what she did since she was deceived by Skavak. The smuggler let her go, and Syreena left the planet, Ord Mantell.

==Behind the scenes==
The Dark Side option is to kill Syreena, of which [[Corso Riggs]] would not approve, but no influence will be lost. He says women should be treated kindly, even if they are back stabbing murderers.
